summary: This Form 8-K filed by La Rosa Holdings Corp. on May 27, 2026, reports entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement with an institutional investor for up to 500 shares of Series D Convertible Preferred Stock at $1,000 per share. The initial closing is 250 shares for $250,000, with the remainder at the company's option. There is no stated acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or management change. It is a routine capital raise involving preferred stock, not a special situation event.
